rationale: With the Chief Justice in dissent, Justice Thomas assigns and is best positioned to write a textualist majority rejecting judge-made fugitive tolling as inconsistent with § 3583’s express timing mechanisms, especially § 3583(i) and the contrast with § 3624(e). The dissent is most likely to be led by the Chief or Justice Kavanaugh advancing the “not serving supervision” theory with an intentional-absconding limiting principle, prompting possible concurrences to emphasize lenity/separation-of-powers or administrability concerns.
